name: kwitch
description: Kwitch — an open-source, production-ready live-streaming platform built on the TRTC AtomicXCore Web SDK.

scripts.//: Convenience scripts that delegate to web/ and server/. Run npm run install:all the first time.
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
